cannabis_purchaser_excise_tax.description: Imposed on the purchaser, by product type and ADJUSTED THC level. Applied to purchase price.

non_infused_thc_le_35.applies_to: Flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, and vapes with adjusted THC <= 35%

non_infused_thc_gt_35.applies_to: Flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, and vapes with adjusted THC > 35%

infused_products.applies_to: Cannabis-infused products only: edibles, tinctures, topicals. Rate is flat regardless of THC.

cannabis_purchaser_excise_tax.CRITICAL_TRAP: Concentrates and vapes are NOT cannabis-infused products. Per 86 Ill. Adm. Code 423.105 they are taxed by adjusted THC (10% or 25%), NOT the 20% infused rate. Do not classify a vape/concentrate as 'infused'.
cannabis_purchaser_excise_tax.adjusted_thc_formula: adjusted_THC% = delta9_THC% + (0.877 * THCa%). Use this against the 35% threshold for non-infused products. Menu-displayed total THC% is usually a close proxy, but where THCa is listed separately, compute it.

state_retailers_occupation_tax.note: Standard 6.25% IL state sales tax (ROT) applies to rec cannabis purchase price.

local_cannabis_retailers_occupation_tax.description: Municipal + county cannabis ROT, specific to cannabis, on top of state. Verified for Peoria-metro jurisdictions.

peoria.source: City of Peoria municipal cannabis ROT

pekin.source: City of Pekin municipal cannabis ROT

canton.confidence: LOW - Canton municipal cannabis ROT NOT independently confirmed this pass; 3.0% is the common default. Verify via MyTax before relying on RISE Canton OTD.

peoria_county.note: 3.0% in incorporated municipalities within the county; up to 3.75% in unincorporated areas. Applies to Peoria + Peoria Heights stores.

tazewell_county.confidence: MEDIUM - No Tazewell County cannabis ROT found in IDOR change bulletins or the East Peoria ordinance (which lists only city 3% + state share + non-home-rule). Treated as 0 pending MyTax verification. Affects East Peoria + Pekin stores.

fulton_county.confidence: MEDIUM - No Fulton County cannabis ROT found. Treated as 0 pending MyTax verification. Affects Canton store.

general_local_sales_tax_addon.description: Beyond the cannabis-specific ROT, the GENERAL MERCHANDISE retailers' occupation tax applies to rec cannabis. Value below = combined general-merchandise rate MINUS the 6.25% state portion already counted in state_retailers_occupation_tax. So total general merch rate = 0.0625 + addon.
general_local_sales_tax_addon.confidence: MEDIUM - city-level rates from 2026 sales-tax aggregators (Avalara/SalesTaxHandbook). Business/special-development districts can raise the rate block-by-block, so the actual rate at a given store address may be higher.

peoria.note: Some Peoria business districts run up to ~10.0% combined (addon ~0.0375). Verify per address.

east_peoria.note: Special business districts (e.g., Levee/Camp St) can reach ~9.5% combined (addon ~0.0325). Riverside Dr / S Main stores may sit in one - verify.

general_local_sales_tax_addon.action_for_code: Per-jurisdiction values are good defaults; for exactness pull the combined general rate per store ADDRESS from IDOR MyTax Tax Rate Finder (mytax.illinois.gov, Jan 2026) - business districts vary by address.

worked_examples._note: Worked examples assume a CITY OF PEORIA store: excise + state ROT 6.25% + general local addon 2.75% (= 9.0% general merch) + muni cannabis 3% + Peoria County cannabis 3%. Effective rate = excise + 9.0% + 3% + 3% = excise + 15%. Use to VALIDATE the tax engine. Other jurisdictions differ - see per_jurisdiction_effective below.

per_jurisdiction_effective._note: Effective OTD rate for an eighth (<=35% THC, excise 10%) = 0.10 + general_merch_combined + muni_cannabis + county_cannabis. Add +0.15 to the non-excise sum for a vape (excise 25%) or +0.10 for an edible (excise 20%) relative to flower. Values use the per_jurisdiction defaults above (Tazewell/Fulton county cannabis = 0).
